units: <cite ref="Tosefta Avodah Zarah 7:13">Tosef. Ab. Zar. VII</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Avodah Zarah 8:13">VIII</cite>), 13 <he>והלא הש׳ ניכר בין למעלה וכ׳</he> ed. Zuck. (oth. ed. <he>פשתם</he>, <cite ref="Q02108"><he>פשתן</he></cite>, corr. acc.) would not the boring (for the sake of getting wine out) be recognized whether on the top or at the bottom?; <cite ref="Avodah Zarah 69b">Ab. Zar. 69ᵇ</cite> <he>שְׁתָמוֹ</he> Ms. M. (Rashi <he>שִׁתּוּמוֹ</he>; early ed. <he>סתמו</he>; later ed. <he>סתומו</he>). Tosef. l. c. 14 <he>אם היה מכיר חותמו ושְׁתָמוֹ</he> ed. Zuck. (Var. <he>וסתמו</he>; <he>ושמו</he>, corr. acc.) if he can identify his seal and the spot and manner of his boring (Var. <he>וסתמו</he> the spot and manner of his closing up); a. e.
